## Editorial acceptance criteria for this rehearsal
The comparison must explain the student's actual decision: upfront payment risk, when an official transcript exists, assessment format, pacing and exact degree applicability. Preserve existing articles and avoid a duplicate generic provider list. Do not promise universal transfer, a particular receiving award, or that every ASU course is unproctored. Retain citations and cost assumptions; test both the product source page and the actual generated article on desktop and phone.
